integrity: The stated finite-field formulas are supported by an explicit uniform proof and an independently implemented exhaustive small-field checker. No independent expert or external audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact formula concerns additive Lie commutators of all upper triangular 3-by-3 matrices over finite fields; does not classify higher sizes, full-matrix algebras, algebraic schemes, or multiplicative group commutators. The four finite-field computations are corroborations rather than an infinite proof. Historical literature coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Exact fibers of the Lie commutator on three-by-three triangular matrices
